summary.ru: Хаменгкубувоно — правящая династия султанов и де-факто губернаторов Джокьякарты в Индонезии, находящаяся у власти с 1755 года.
summary.en: Hamengkubuwono is the current ruling royal house of the Yogyakarta Sultanate in the Special Region of Yogyakarta of Indonesia. The reigning Sultan of Yogyakarta is the hereditary Governor of the Special Region with terms of 5 years without bounded by periodic provision (article 25 paragraph 2), as normally applied to such public office. The current Sultan is Hamengkubuwono X.
